dial.summary: BTC slipped back to ~$59.7K on Nov 28 (Fear & Greed Extreme Fear: 12) with TOTAL at $2.06T, while DXY closed Nov 27 at 104.03 after touching a 20-month high of 104.57 intraweek; however, Global M2 holds at $104.2T (4-week trend up), perp funding remains near zero at 0.0038%, and BTC.D held firm at 58.45% — keeping the BTC Accumulation thesis intact as Dec 1 ISM Manufacturing and Dec 4 NFP are the next catalysts ahead of the Dec 9 FOMC decision.

indicators.name: Global Liquidity (Global M2)
indicators.note: StreetStats 4-economy basket at $104.2T as of November 27–28, 2026; US M2 component ~$23.5T (+5.9% YoY per Nowflation Oct 2026 reading); 4-week trend UP — from ~$103.9T on Oct 27 to $104.2T on Nov 28 (+$0.3T); no YoY contraction signal; status supportive (4-week trend up); next US M2 release December 22, 2026.

indicators.name: ISM Manufacturing PMI
indicators.note: October 2026 ISM Manufacturing PMI at 55.5% (released November 2, above consensus 54.6%), up from September's 54.5%; 4-week trend UP (Sep 54.5 → Oct 55.5, +1.0pp); Production sub-index 59.0 (highest since Nov 2021), New Orders 55.5, Employment 52.4; status supportive (above 50 and rising, 10th consecutive expansion month); November 2026 ISM Manufacturing PMI releases December 1, 2026 at 10:00 AM ET — the next print; S&P Global November flash estimate was 54.5 (eased from 54.9), diverging from ISM; consensus for the official ISM Nov reading ~55.1.

indicators.name: DXY (US Dollar Index)
indicators.note: ICE DXY closed Nov 27 at 104.03 (Riotimes +0.36%, Trading Economics 104.027; intraweek high of 104.57 — a 20-month high); 4-week trend UP — Oct 27 close ~102.32 vs Nov 27 close 104.03 = +1.71pts (+1.67%), above 0.5% flat threshold; status headwind (ICE DXY 104.03 above 100 threshold); FRED DTWEXBGS blocked this session — trend confirmed via public sources; 52-week range 95.55–104.57.

indicators.name: Real Yields (US10Y - CPI)
indicators.note: 10-year TIPS real yield (DFII10) at 2.79% as of November 24, 2026 (most recent confirmed FRED observation; Nov 26 Thanksgiving holiday = no trading; Nov 27 half-day session value not surfaced); 4-week trend UP — Oct 27 close ~2.64% vs Nov 24 2.79% = +15bps, above 5bps flat threshold; status headwind (rising trend and above 2%); FRED API blocked this session — value sourced from FRED series page via web; next DFII10 reading should be available Monday Dec 1.

indicators.name: 2s10s Yield Curve
indicators.note: 2s10s spread ~22bps at Nov 27 close: 10yr 4.94% (Riotimes, Yahoo Finance), 2yr 4.72% (Yahoo Finance weekly recap) = +22bps; DWK Alpha had earlier morning read of +21.4bps (2yr 4.65%, 10yr 4.86%); 4-week comparison: Oct 27 close 10yr ~4.99%, 2yr ~4.70% = +29.3bps vs Nov 27 +22bps = DOWN (flattened ~7bps); curve remains well above -50bps headwind threshold; status neutral (positive but not steepening).

indicators.name: Fed Balance Sheet
indicators.note: WALCL at $6,741,452M ($6.74T) as of November 18, 2026 per Federal Reserve H.4.1; Nov 11: $6,758,867M; Nov 4: $6,748,145M; Oct 28: $6,745,635M; Nov 27 H.4.1 release (covering Nov 25 balance) not surfaced in search results this run; 4-week comparison: Oct 28 $6.746T → Nov 18 $6.741T = -$5B = -0.07%, within flat threshold; balance sheet ~$186B higher YoY; status supportive (QT effectively paused, balance sheet stable).

indicators.name: BTC Funding Rates (perps avg)
indicators.note: BTC perpetual OI-weighted funding rate approximately 0.0038% per 8h as of November 27–28, 2026; Au79 Nov 27 note reported funding compressed to range +0.0013%–+0.0048% as BTC pulled back; CoinFuty showing -0.0017% OI-weighted with exchange range -0.0100% (HTX) to +0.0100% (OKX); some venues briefly went negative on Nov 28 sell-off (-3.3%); 30-day trend FLAT — consistently near zero throughout November; CoinGlass blocked this session; status supportive (OI-weighted average well below 0.04% headwind threshold, with slight negative at some venues suggesting healthy deleveraging).

indicators.name: Stablecoin Dominance
indicators.note: Stablecoin market cap ~$281.3B (cryptonews.net Nov 26: USDT+USDC control 86.5% of $281.3B supply; down from ~$289B on Nov 27 and peak ~$309.7B in May); TOTAL crypto market cap $2.06T (Coincodex Nov 28 daily update: BTC at $59,736, BTC.D 58.45%, TOTAL fell from $2.11T to $2.06T in 24h); derived dominance $281.3B/$2.06T ≈ 13.7%; 30-day trend UP — Oct 27 TOTAL ~$2.6T, stables ~$296B ≈ 11.5% vs current 13.7%; status neutral (dominance rising but TOTAL fell from $2.6T — headwind requires BOTH rising simultaneously, not met); CoinGecko blocked this session.

upcoming.title: ISM Manufacturing PMI (November 2026)
upcoming.note: ISM releases November 2026 Manufacturing PMI at 10:00 AM ET (first business day of December); October reading was 55.5 (10th consecutive expansion month, above consensus 54.6%); consensus for November is ~55.1; a continuation above 55 reinforces the late-cycle expansion narrative heading into the December 9 FOMC meeting; Prices Paid sub-index closely watched given elevated input cost pressures in October.

upcoming.title: JOLTS Job Openings (October 2026)
upcoming.note: BLS releases October 2026 JOLTS at 10:00 AM ET; a print above 8M openings would reinforce the tight labor market narrative supporting the December 9 rate decision; the quits rate is a leading indicator of wage growth; released 3 days before the November NFP (December 4).

upcoming.title: ADP Private Employment (November 2026)
upcoming.note: ADP releases November 2026 National Employment Report at 8:15 AM ET; private sector payroll estimate published 2 days before the official BLS NFP (December 4); a print above 200K would align with the strong labor market narrative ahead of the December 9 FOMC decision.

upcoming.title: ISM Services PMI (November 2026)
upcoming.note: ISM releases November 2026 Non-Manufacturing (Services) PMI at 10:00 AM ET; services sector activity closely watched given the Fed's focus on services inflation; a reading above 55 would reinforce the tight labor/services backdrop heading into the December 9 FOMC meeting; released one day before November NFP.

upcoming.title: NFP (November 2026 Jobs Report)
upcoming.note: BLS releases November 2026 Non-Farm Payrolls at 8:30 AM ET (first Friday of December); last major labor market print before the December 9 FOMC decision; a print above 200K alongside low unemployment would reinforce the rate action case; average hourly earnings closely watched for second-round inflation signals.
